verdict.rationale: The documented scaling path runs from a one-line local Docker quickstart (elastic-docs-5, elastic-docs-17) to Elastic Cloud Serverless, which autoscales and scales search and index tiers independently (elastic-docs-21, elastic-docs-27, elastic-docs-33). Community reports show self-managed clusters running on Kubernetes via the ECK operator and StatefulSets with cluster-health-aware shutdown (elastic-comm-12, elastic-comm-13). A Jepsen report of document loss during network partitions on an older version lowers confidence in resiliency claims (elastic-comm-11). Missing for 10: first-party docs on replication, sharding, and high-availability configuration; evidence of operation at hundreds of millions of documents; current independent resiliency corroboration.
